battle.name: 馬恩河
battle.brief: 德軍右翼在巴黎以東停住。鐵路把法軍預備隊與75野戰砲送進缺口，砲火封住馬恩河與奧爾克河上的渡口渡橋，第五軍星夜兼程趕到缺口正面。這一週比任何一次白刃衝鋒更早決定西線的樣子：運動戰收場，壕溝線自此沿河拉開。

kit.name: 法國 75
kit.history: 液壓駐退讓射速遠超舊砲。馬恩河的勝算裡有它，也有把砲運到對的車站的鐵路。

countries: 一九一四年九月六日至十二日，馬恩河戰役在西線北段打響，交戰雙方是法蘭西第三共和國、大英帝國與德意志帝國。法軍方面，總參謀部是最高指揮機關，霞飛在八月底把作戰指揮權集中在自己手上，第五軍由德·朗格爾·德·卡里指揮，第六軍由弗朗謝·德斯佩雷指揮，莫諾里少將率領第九軍，巴黎要塞與後備軍由加利尼整編，霞飛另以福煦主持北部戰線的協同。英國方面，遠征軍由約翰·弗蘭奇爵士率領，總兵力約七萬三千人，初期投入的只有第二軍的第三、第四師，歸史密斯-多里恩中將指揮。德軍方面，威廉二世居最高統帥位，總參謀長小毛奇在總部主持全局，右翼由克魯克的第一軍與比洛的第二軍構成，旗下有馮·阿爾尼姆的第四預備軍、路特維茨的第九預備軍，另有騎兵預備師、工兵與汽車連。除兩大交戰國外，德軍侵犯比利時中立激起英國參戰，比利時軍隊在安特衛普與里爾一線的頑抗使德軍右翼多耗一周；俄軍在東線牽制德軍一部；義大利于當時仍屬中立，直到一九一五年才加入協約國。戰役之後，兩軍在馬恩河至埃納河之間拉出正面百餘公里的對峙線，主動權誰也沒有再握，壕溝時代自此開始。
countriesEn: From 6 to 12 September 1914 the Battle of the Marne was fought on the northern stretch of the Western Front between the French Third Republic, the British Empire and the German Empire. On the French side the General Headquarters was the supreme command organ: Joffre concentrated operational control in his own hands at the end of August, the Fifth Army was commanded by de Langle de Cary, the Sixth Army by Franchet d'Espèrey, the IX Corps was led by General Maunoury, the garrison of Paris and the reserve army were organized by Gallieni, and Foch handled coordination on the northern front. On the British side the Expeditionary Force was led by Sir John French with a total strength of about 73,000 men; at first only the 3rd and 4th Divisions of II Corps were in contact, under Horace Smith-Dorrien. On the German side Wilhelm II was the supreme commander and the younger Moltke directed operations from the headquarters; the right wing was formed by von Kluck's First Army and von Bülow's Second Army, with von Arnim's IV Reserve Corps and von Lüttwitz's IX Reserve Corps under them, plus the cavalry reserve divisions, engineers and motor transport columns. Alongside the two great belligerents, the German violation of Belgian neutrality brought Britain into the war, and the stubborn Belgian resistance at Antwerp and Lille cost the German right wing an extra week; the Russian army tied down part of the Germans on the Eastern Front; Italy was still neutral at the time and only joined the Entente in 1915. After the battle the two armies drew out a front of more than a hundred kilometres between the Marne and the Aisne, neither side held the initiative again, and the era of the trench began.
people: 法軍方面的關鍵人物是加利尼與霞飛。加利尼在八月最後數日出任陸軍部長，組織巴黎守軍與後備隊，把本可用於進攻的兵力留在缺口之外，後世稱他為這場戰役的組織者；霞飛則在九月初把法軍主力調頭北上，集中第五、第六兩軍與英軍遠征軍對付德軍右翼，他九月七日發出的電文說「我的中央在退，我的右翼在退，情況危急，我在各處反攻」，福煦的答覆則是「我的中央在退……我將繼續守住中央」——這段對話的原文流傳有出入，但大體可靠。前線上，德·朗格爾·德·卡里的第五軍與弗朗謝·德斯佩雷的第六軍交替掩護，莫諾里的第九軍只有兩個摩洛哥師，在奧爾克河畔遲滯一日，軍界普遍認為德軍得以突破缺口與此有關；英軍方面，史密斯-多里恩的第二軍在奧爾克河右岸頂住德軍北翼的衝擊，遠征軍的作用在戰後受到英國官方反覆強調。德軍方面，克魯克的第一軍連日急行，力主在缺口形成前強渡馬恩河，其指揮部因顧慮巴黎方向的側翼而猶豫不決；比洛的第二軍在小毛奇於九月八日下令後才展開對法軍第五軍的反擊；九月九日威廉二世與小毛奇下令全線撤退，結束了德軍「向巴黎行軍」的想法。戰後的史家則指出，所謂德軍被包圍潰散並非事實，撤退是總參謀部的有意決策。
peopleEn: The decisive French figures were Gallieni and Joffre. Gallieni became Minister of War in the last days of August, organized the Paris garrison and the reserve army, and kept troops that could have been used for the attack out of the gap; later generations called him the organizer of the battle. Joffre turned the main body of the French army north in early September, concentrating the Fifth and Sixth Armies and the British Expeditionary Force against the German right wing; his telegram of 7 September read that his centre was giving way, his right was retreating, the situation was critical and he was attacking everywhere, and Foch's answer was that his centre was giving way, his right was retreating, the situation was critical and he would continue to hold the centre. The exact wording of that exchange survives in variant forms but its substance is reliable. At the front the Fifth Army under de Langle de Cary and the Sixth Army under Franchet d'Espèrey covered each other in turn. Maunoury's IX Corps had only two Moroccan divisions and delayed for a day on the Ourcq, and the French army has generally held this partly responsible for the German penetration. On the British side Smith-Dorrien's II Corps absorbed the German thrust on the right bank of the Ourcq, and the role of the Expeditionary Force was stressed repeatedly afterwards by the British authorities. On the German side von Kluck's First Army pressed forward day after day and argued for crossing the Marne before the gap could close, while its command hesitated out of concern for its exposed flank towards Paris; von Bülow's Second Army launched its counter-stroke against the French Fifth Army only after the order of 8 September; on 9 September Wilhelm II and Moltke ordered a general retreat, ending the German idea of the march on Paris. Later historians pointed out that the German army was not enveloped and destroyed: the withdrawal was a deliberate decision of the General Staff.
kits: 法國75（Canon de 75 modèle 1897）是馬恩河戰役中法軍砲兵的主幹，也是本場戰役最關鍵的裝備。它是法國自行設計的75毫米速射野戰砲，一八九七年定型，採用獨特的液壓液氣式駐退：砲身後座時壓縮的液體推動活塞吸收能量，不需要沉重的駐退機與大架，整砲重心低、重量輕，可由六匹馬拖行，也可用卡車牽引，甚至能邊行進邊射擊。初速每秒七百二十米，射界平直，最大射程約一萬一千至一萬二千公尺，標準射速每分鐘十五至二十發，火力密度遠超各國的舊式野戰砲。射擊以二十發一組的速射裝藥夾供彈，分四個步驟裝填，一門砲一分鐘內可傾瀉近二百發。開戰時法軍野戰砲隊以它為主力，營與團都配有，師屬砲兵有十二個75砲連與六個105公厘連，其射擊準則是靠每秒七百二十米的平直彈道封住河谷渡口與橋面，讓德軍縱隊在開闊地上挨打。它同時是法軍「向不可見目標射擊」理論的物理基礎：敵砲位尚未進入視線時就可先以高初速、大射界打擊隱蔽目標，縮短敵軍從發現到還擊的時間。法國75的設計也配合鐵路運載：整砲可拆成砲身、炮架與彈藥車分件上車，到前線火車站再組裝，因此開戰後兩個月的產量可以源源不斷送到前線。其餘裝備包括法軍勒貝爾1886式步槍、哈奇開斯1908與1914式輕機槍、155公厘Bange式無駐退榴彈砲；德軍則有7.7公厘FK 96野戰砲、10.5公厘leFH 16與15公厘重榴彈砲、MG 08重機槍、毛瑟Gewehr 98步槍，以及最早一批汽車輸送連。戰馬、載重汽車、火車與飛艇構成雙方的機動與補給骨幹。
kitsEn: The Canon de 75 modèle 1897 was the backbone of French artillery at the Marne and the most important piece of equipment in the battle. It was a French-designed 75mm quick-firing field gun, finalized in 1897, using a unique hydro-pneumatic recoil system: the energy of the barrel's recoil was absorbed by fluid compressed behind a piston, so no heavy recoil mechanism and no heavy carriage frame were needed; the gun had a low centre of gravity and was light enough to be towed by six horses, hauled by a truck, and even fired while on the move. Its muzzle velocity was 720 metres per second on a flat trajectory, its maximum range roughly 11,000 to 12,000 metres, and its standard rate of fire fifteen to twenty rounds a minute, a density of fire far beyond that of the older field guns in other armies. It was fed by twenty-round clips loaded in four separate stages, and a single gun could put nearly two hundred rounds down within a minute. At the outbreak of war the 75 was the mainstay of the French field artillery, down to battalion and regimental level, while divisional artillery held twelve batteries of 75s and six of 105mm; its firing doctrine was to seal the crossings of the river valleys and the bridgeheads with the flat trajectory of the 720 metres per second shell, catching German columns in the open. It was also the physical basis of the French doctrine of fire at the invisible point: hidden enemy batteries could be engaged before they came into view, shortening the time the enemy needed to see the target and return fire. The design of the French 75 also matched rail transport: the gun could be broken into barrel, carriage and limber for loading on standard gauge wagons and reassembled at the forward stations, so the production of the first two months of the war could be delivered to the front without interruption. The rest of the equipment included the French Lebel Model 1886 rifle, the Hotchkiss Model 1908 and 1914 light machine guns and the 155mm Bange howitzer without recoil mechanism; on the German side the 7.7cm FK 96 field gun, the 10.5cm leFH 16 and 15cm heavy howitzers, the MG 08 heavy machine gun, the Mauser Gewehr 98 rifle and the first motor transport columns, with horses, lorries, trains and airships forming the backbone of movement and supply on both sides.
tactics: 德軍的戰法就是速度本身：克魯克的第一軍自默茲河畔向西北疾進，每日推進二三十公里，以行軍縱隊而非戰術縱隊作戰，力圖在法軍完成動員前切過巴黎東側；比洛的第二軍與之相隔十餘公里，兩軍之間的缺口全靠一個騎兵旅警戒。德軍並沒有把這場戰役當成會被擋住的消耗戰來準備。後勤脫節很快顯形：前進速度超過馬車輸送的極限，砲彈與糧秣在師級單位裡大量不足。法軍方面，第九軍在奧爾克河畔的遲滯讓德軍一度滲透到馬恩河北岸的溪谷地帶，第六軍九月六日的反擊把德軍擋在河東；九月七日德軍第二軍先頭抵達馬恩河並架橋強渡，缺口成形，第五軍以急行軍姿態在四十八小時內趕到費爾-香佩努瓦一線堵住裂口，同時英軍第二軍在北面奧爾克河頂住德軍第九預備軍的反衝，缺口才沒有變成包圍，關鍵是各部隊在同一條線上接上了。法國75在其中的角色是節點火力：砲兵連以營為單位在縱深展開，接到命令後以平直彈道射擊渡口與橋面，一個75砲連四門砲一分鐘可打出八十發，把德軍在河谷開闊地上的縱隊壓成散兵；砲兵連同時把砲位從前線後撤，用「向不可見目標射擊」壓制隱蔽的德軍砲位，掩護己方步兵反擊，砲兵連的位移速度是法軍反擊能跟上德軍機動作戰的關鍵。九月八日至九日德軍在費爾-香佩努瓦一線試圖反擊，把法軍右翼壓回，但補給線拉長、馬車輸送不敷，攻勢無法持久；九月九日毛奇下令全線撤退，第一軍於九月十日至十二日退過馬恩河與埃納河，德軍以機槍與榴彈砲掩護退卻，最後在布基尼一線隔奧爾克河與法軍相對，壕溝線就此成形。空軍在這一役只起觀察作用，雙方幾次偵察飛行都未能改變砲兵部署。
tacticsEn: The German method was speed itself: von Kluck's First Army swept north-west from the Meuse, advancing twenty or thirty kilometres a day, fighting in march columns rather than tactical columns, in the hope of cutting across the eastern side of Paris before the French completed mobilization; von Bülow's Second Army followed ten or more kilometres behind, and the gap between the two armies was covered by a single cavalry brigade. The Germans had not prepared this campaign as a war that might be checked, and the breakdown of supply became visible early, because the rate of advance exceeded the limit of what horse transport could sustain, leaving ammunition and food short at divisional level. On the French side the delay of the IX Corps on the Ourcq allowed the Germans for a time to infiltrate the valleys north of the Marne, and the counter-stroke of the Sixth Army on 6 September held them east of the river; on 7 September the leading elements of von Bülow's Second Army reached the Marne, bridged it and forced a crossing, the gap opened, and the Fifth Army, moving at forced march pace, reached the Fère-Champenoise front within forty-eight hours to plug it, while the British II Corps held the German IX Reserve Corps on the Ourcq to the north so that the gap did not become an encirclement; what mattered was that the formations closed up on a single line. The role of the French 75 was the fire of decision: batteries were deployed in depth, and on the order the flat-trajectory shells were fired onto the crossings and bridgeheads, four guns of a 75 battery putting eighty rounds onto the target within a minute and breaking the German columns in the open valley into skirmishers; at the same time the batteries displaced their guns to the rear and used fire at the invisible point to silence hidden German batteries and cover the French counter-attack, and the speed with which the batteries could displace was what allowed French artillery to keep up with the German movement. Between 8 and 9 September the Germans tried to counter-attack on the Fère-Champenoise front and pushed the French right back, but with supply lines stretched and horse transport exhausted the offensive could not be sustained; on 9 September Moltke ordered a general retreat, the First Army withdrew across the Marne and the Aisne between 10 and 12 September, the Germans covered the withdrawal with machine guns and howitzers, and at last they faced the French across the Ourcq on the Béquigny line, where the trench line took shape. Aircraft played only an observational role, and neither side's reconnaissions changed the artillery deployment.
data: 時間與距離：戰役自一九一四年九月六日法軍發動反擊起，到九月十二日德軍退過馬恩河、陣線固定為止，主要戰鬥集中在九日與十日；德軍自默茲河畔出發到抵達馬恩河，前後約十天、行程逾二百公里，最急的幾天每日推進二三十公里，第五軍則在四十八小時內急行約五十至六十公里趕赴缺口。兵力：法軍在關鍵時刻可用兵力約十萬人，以第五、第六兩軍為主，另有後備軍與巴黎守軍；英國遠征軍總兵力約七萬三千人，但真正投入戰鬥的只有第二軍的第三、第四師，合計約一萬五千人；德軍右翼第一、第二兩軍合計約二十萬人上下，其中在奧爾克河與費爾-香佩努瓦方向作戰的師約在五萬至六萬之間。砲兵：法軍一個師約有十二個75砲連共四十八門75與六個105公厘連，英軍遠征軍每師有十二門18磅砲、四門60磅砲與六門6吋榴彈砲，德軍師屬砲兵以7.7公厘FK 96為主力。傷亡：法軍約一萬至一萬二千人，英軍初期傷亡數千人，德軍約二萬四千至三萬人；各方檔案的統計口徑不一，宜作量級參考。後勤量級：一門法國75一次射擊要消耗二十發，每發含藥包約六公斤，一個75砲連以每分鐘八十發計，一分鐘即耗去近半噸銅殼與發射藥；維持一個法軍師作戰約需每日十列火車的火車與馬車運力，而德軍第一軍的行軍補給線此時已拉長到數十公里以上、幾乎全靠馬車，這正是德軍攻勢無法持續的物理原因。
dataEn: Timing and distance: the battle ran from the French counter-stroke of 6 September 1914 to the German withdrawal across the Marne and the fixing of the front on 12 September, with the main fighting falling on the 9th and 10th; the Germans took about ten days and more than two hundred kilometres to go from the Meuse to the Marne, at their fastest advancing twenty or thirty kilometres a day, while the Fifth Army covered some fifty to sixty kilometres in forty-eight hours to reach the gap. Manpower: about 100,000 Frenchmen were available at the decisive moment, chiefly the Fifth and Sixth Armies with parts of the reserve army and the Paris garrison; the British Expeditionary Force numbered about 73,000 men in total, but only the 3rd and 4th Divisions of II Corps, roughly 15,000 men, were actually engaged; the German First and Second Armies on the right wing together numbered around 200,000, of whom some 50,000 to 60,000 were in the divisions fighting along the Ourcq and at Fère-Champenoise. Artillery: a French division held about twelve batteries of 75s, forty-eight guns, and six batteries of 105mm; a British division in the Expeditionary Force had twelve 18-pounder field guns, four 60-pounders and six 6-inch howitzers; German divisional artillery was built on the 7.7cm FK 96. Casualties: the French lost about 10,000 to 12,000 men, the British several thousand in the first phase, the Germans about 24,000 to 30,000; the accounting differs from source to source and these figures should be read as orders of magnitude. Logistical scale: one firing cycle of a French 75 consumes twenty rounds of about six kilograms each with the charge, and a 75 battery firing eighty rounds a minute burns nearly half a tonne of cartridge cases and propellant in a single minute; keeping one French division in action needed the daily capacity of about ten trains plus horse transport, while the German First Army's supply line by then stretched tens of kilometres and depended almost entirely on horses, which is the physical reason the German offensive could not be sustained.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。遠因是德國的施里芬計畫本身：一九一三年以後德軍總參謀部相信，只要在俄軍完成動員前迫使法國接受速決，法國就會退出戰爭，因此計畫要求第一軍以每日數十公里的速度穿過比利時與法國北部，從巴黎東側迂迴，再回師攻擊暴露的左翼，一九一四年九月二日一份標明右翼行軍部署的命令副本在法軍巡邏隊手中被繳獲，成為法軍得以重組防線的關鍵情報。中因是德軍在八月初侵入比利時、又於法國北境迅速突破，比利時的中立與法國北部城鎮的失守震驚西歐；德軍以為法軍主力尚在南部與前線南方，前線經過疏散與徵召並未完成集結，第九師在蘇瓦松附近的缺口因此在法軍尚未接上防線時被突破。即因是後勤與指揮：德軍右翼把速度放在補給之前，馬車輸送無法跟上每日二三十公里的推進，第一軍與第二軍之間的缺口只能靠一個騎兵旅掩蓋；法軍則靠鐵路把預備隊與砲彈在幾日內送到正確的火車站，再以急行軍插上缺口，第五軍的及時趕到成了扭轉戰局的著眼點。這場戰役因此不單是兩軍裝備與士氣的對比，更是兩個國家動員與運輸體系的對比。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause. In the long run it was the Schlieffen Plan itself: after 1913 the German General Staff believed that if it could force a decision on France before Russia finished mobilization, France would leave the war, so the plan demanded that the First Army cross Belgium and northern France at thirty or more kilometres a day, swing round the eastern side of Paris and then turn back on the exposed French left wing; on 2 September 1914 a copy of the deployment order for the right wing fell into the hands of a French patrol, and that captured document became the key intelligence on which France rebuilt its front. In the medium term, the German invasion of Belgium in early August and the rapid breakthrough in northern France shocked western Europe, and the Germans believed the main French army was still in the south and behind the front, which had been thinned by the outpouring of reservists and had not finished concentrating, so the gap opened near Soissons before the French could plug it. In the immediate term it was logistics and command: the German right wing put speed ahead of supply, horse transport could not keep up with an advance of twenty or thirty kilometres a day, and the gap between the First and Second Armies could only be covered by a cavalry brigade; the French, by contrast, used the railways to bring reserves and shells to the right stations within days and then rushed them into the gap, and the timely arrival of the Fifth Army was the hinge on which the battle turned. The battle was therefore not only a comparison of equipment and morale between two armies, but a comparison between the mobilization and transport systems of two countries.
impact: 影響至少有四層。第一，戰爭的性質在這一週改變：德軍「向巴黎行軍」的想法被放棄，兩軍在馬恩河至埃納河之間拉出的對峙線，此後四年沒有大的移動，壕溝、鐵絲網與砲兵戰成為西線的常態，歐洲的運動戰時代就此結束，馬恩河與凡爾登、索姆河同列為西線三大消耗戰的源頭。第二，戰略主動權轉到協約國手上：法英聯軍在開戰後第一次把德軍逐回，之後德軍再未取得戰役層面的戰略主動。第三，神話與記憶：這場戰役在法國被稱為「馬恩河的奇蹟」，並被用來支撐一九一四年共和國的「神聖聯盟」說法與全民團結的敘事；德國方面長期流傳德軍是被包圍潰散的說法，二戰後的史學研究多已修正，德軍退卻是總參謀部有意識的決策，第九預備軍與第一軍各師並未被切斷，退路與埃納河渡口都握在德軍手中，「數個軍被包圍」是戰後傳說而非事實，但「奇蹟」之說本身也掩蓋了法軍的運氣與情報因素。第四，後勤與砲兵技術層面，鐵路運輸與汽車運輸團成為法軍此後的制度性優勢，法國75的高初速、液壓駐退與速射裝填則成為各國野戰砲設計的參照，一九一五年後各國相繼仿製或改良的野戰速射砲，在結構上都能從法國75找到影子，而它的成功也讓各國明白，砲兵的第一要素不是口徑而是射速、精度與可機動性。
impactEn: The consequences worked on at least four levels. First, the nature of the war changed within that week: the German idea of the march on Paris was abandoned, and the front the two armies drew out between the Marne and the Aisne was not to move significantly for four years, with trenches, wire and artillery war becoming the normal condition of the Western Front; the age of movement warfare in Europe ended, and the Marne stands with Verdun and the Somme as one of the three great attritional battles of the Western Front. Second, the strategic initiative passed to the Entente: for the first time since the war began the Franco-British forces drove the Germans back, and the Germans never again won the strategic initiative at the level of a campaign. Third, myth and memory: the battle was called the miracle of the Marne in France and used to support the rhetoric of the sacred union of the republic in 1914 and the story of national unity; in Germany a long-standing tale held that the German army had been enveloped and destroyed, and post-war historiography has largely corrected this, for the German withdrawal was a deliberate decision of the General Staff, the IX Reserve Corps and the divisions of the First Army were not cut off, the retreat route and the crossings of the Aisne stayed in German hands, and the story of several armies encircled is a later legend rather than fact, even though the miracle itself also disguised French luck and good intelligence. Fourth, at the level of logistics and artillery technique: rail transport and the motor transport columns became a structural advantage for the French army thereafter, while the high muzzle velocity, hydro-pneumatic recoil and rapid clip loading of the French 75 became a reference for foreign field gun design; the quick-firing field guns other armies developed or improved after 1915 can all be traced in structural terms to the French 75, whose success also taught every army that the first requirement of artillery was not calibre but rate of fire, accuracy and mobility.
result: 結果是德軍攻勢在馬恩河被截停，兩軍沿河相對：法軍第五、第六軍佔據河線，英軍第二軍在北面接上，巴黎陷落的危機解除；德軍第一軍退過馬恩河後在埃納河重新站住，之後在索姆河與凡爾登方向的攻勢都沒有改變西線的基本格局。陣地上，馬恩河東岸至埃納河的線在九月十二日之後被大量掘壕工事固定，德軍在埃納河一線第一次大規模以機槍與迫擊砲組成火力帶，法軍則把75野戰砲大批下放到固定砲位，砲兵第一次真正按「集中射擊」而非逐門射擊作戰，此後西線的砲兵密度成為各國陸軍競賽的項目。兵器上，法國75在此役中確立了野戰砲的標準地位：它不是靠數量取勝，而是靠初速、射速與可機動性，讓法軍在砲兵對射中取得優勢；同時也暴露了法軍基於平時歐洲假想敵的砲兵體系在面對德軍戰略集中時的應變不足。名稱上，「馬恩河」從此既指一九一四年這場阻止德軍攻勢的戰役，也指一九一八年七月在同一片土地上法軍發動、決定大戰結局的第二次馬恩河戰役——兩役同在史家筆下，成為德法兩國在兩次大戰中同一條河、同一段防線的兩次對峙。
resultEn: The result was that the German offensive was cut off at the Marne and the two armies faced each other along the river: the French Fifth and Sixth Armies held the river line, the British II Corps closed in to the north, and the threat of the fall of Paris was removed; the German First Army withdrew across the Marne and re-established itself on the Aisne, and the later German offensives on the Somme and around Verdun changed nothing in the basic shape of the Western Front. On the ground, the line from the east bank of the Marne to the Aisne was fixed after 12 September by extensive entrenchment; the Germans used machine guns and mortars on a large scale for the first time to build a fire belt along the Aisne, while the French moved their 75 field guns in bulk into fixed emplacements, and artillery for the first time fought truly by massed fire rather than gun by gun, after which the density of artillery on the Western Front became a subject of competition between the armies. As for the weapon, the French 75 established the standard for the field gun in this battle: it won not by numbers but by muzzle velocity, rate of fire and mobility, giving the French an advantage in the artillery duel, while at the same time exposing the weakness of a French artillery system built around the peacetime European enemy when confronted with German concentration of fire. In terms of the name, the Marne came to mean the battle of 1914 that stopped the German offensive and also the second Battle of the Marne of July 1918, launched by the French on the same ground and decisive for the outcome of the great war — two battles fought over the same river and the same stretch of defence in the two world wars.
